name: Helpers & discovery
blurb: Start here. These resolve your workspace by human-readable name so nothing downstream has to guess an ID.

tools.name: fc_get_groups_projects
tools.desc: Groups, projects and their apps keyed by readable name. The preferred first call in any conversation — call once, reuse the result.

tools.name: fc_fetch_current_session
tools.desc: The current user and session, including raw groups and projects. Call once at the start rather than repeatedly.

tools.name: fc_add_item_by_names
tools.desc: Add an item to an app inside a project by name instead of ID. Tasks are supported today.
params: App name, e.g. Tasks, Discussions, Issue Tracker.
Title of the item to add.

tools.name: fc_add_comment_by_names
tools.desc: Comment on any item, naming the app instead of passing a numeric app_id.
params: ID of the task, issue or discussion to comment on.
App name that owns the item.

tools.name: fc_update_status
tools.desc: Update a task's status with a single call.
params: ID of the task to update.
0 not started, 1 completed, 2 in progress, 3 invalid, 4 review.

name: Projects
blurb: Create, edit, favourite and leave projects. Overview returns the project's dashboard summary.

tools.name: fc_fetch_projects
tools.desc: Every project, flat — no group or app context. Prefer fc_get_groups_projects.

tools.name: fc_fetch_project
tools.desc: A single project by ID.
params: ID of the project to fetch.

tools.name: fc_fetch_recent_project_ids
tools.desc: IDs of the projects you touched most recently.

tools.name: fc_add_project
tools.desc: Create a project, optionally inside a new or existing group.
params: Hex colour without the leading #, e.g. 1C7160.
Default task view — list or board.
Freedcamp usage-type ID for the project template.
Existing group to create the project under.
Name for a new group to create for it.

tools.name: fc_edit_project
tools.desc: Rename a project, recolour it, or move it between groups.
params: ID of the project to edit.
Move the project to this group.

tools.name: fc_leave_project
tools.desc: Leave a project you are a member of.
params: Your membership ID — not the project ID.

tools.name: fc_delete_project
tools.desc: Permanently delete a project.
params: ID of the project to delete.

tools.name: fc_fetch_overview
tools.desc: The project's overview payload — progress, activity and app summaries.

tools.name: fc_add_favorite_project
tools.desc: Pin a project to your favourites.

tools.name: fc_delete_favorite_project
tools.desc: Remove a project from your favourites.

name: Tasks
blurb: The busiest group. Tasks carry status, priority, assignee, dates, recurrence, subtasks, tags and custom fields — and can be edited 500 at a time.

tools.name: fc_fetch_task
tools.desc: A single task by ID.
params: ID of the task to fetch.

tools.name: fc_fetch_tasks
tools.desc: List tasks with filters and sorting. Omit project_id to search across every project you can see.
params: Restrict to one project. Omit for all accessible projects.
Only tasks assigned to these user IDs.
Only tasks created by this user.
1 includes tasks from archived lists; 0 is the default.
Filter by parent list status — active or archived.

tools.name: fc_add_task
tools.desc: Create a task, with scheduling, recurrence, assignment, attachments, subtasks and custom fields.
params: Body text — plain text or HTML.
Task list to place it in. Omit for the project default.
Legacy alias for list_id. Send one or the other.
YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss. Surfaces in the calendar.
0 not started, 1 completed, 2 in progress, 3 invalid, 4 review.
Parent task, making this a subtask. Same list, and the parent cannot itself be a subtask.

tools.name: fc_update_task
tools.desc: Update any field on a task, move it between lists, or make it a subtask.
params: ID of the task to update.
Move the task to this list.
0 not started, 1 completed, 2 in progress, 3 invalid, 4 review.
New start date. Empty string clears it.
New recurrence. Empty string stops recurrence.
New parent. Empty string promotes a subtask back to top level.

tools.name: fc_batch_edit_tasks
tools.desc: Apply the same change to up to 500 tasks in one request. Only the fields you send change.
params: Status to set on every listed task.
Priority to set on every listed task.
Single assignee for all of them.
Multiple assignees, replacing the current set.
New title for every listed task.
New description for every listed task.
Parent task to nest them under.

tools.name: fc_delete_task
tools.desc: Delete a task.
params: ID of the task to delete.

name: Lists
blurb: Lists are the containers inside an app — task lists, discussion folders, wiki folders. app_id defaults to 2 (Tasks).

tools.name: fc_fetch_lists
tools.desc: Lists for a project, for one app.
params: App the lists belong to. Default 2 (Tasks).

tools.name: fc_add_list
tools.desc: Create a list.
params: App to create it under. Default 2 (Tasks).

tools.name: fc_edit_list
tools.desc: Rename or re-describe a list.
params: ID of the list to edit.
App the list belongs to. Default 2.

tools.name: fc_delete_list
tools.desc: Delete a list.
params: ID of the list to delete.
App the list belongs to. Default 2.

name: Comments
blurb: One comment surface for every app. Pass the app_id that owns the item, or use fc_add_comment_by_names.

tools.name: fc_add_comment
tools.desc: Comment on a task, issue, discussion or any other item.
params: ID of the item to comment on.
App that owns the item — 2 Tasks, 3 Discussions, 13 Issue Tracker.

tools.name: fc_edit_comment
tools.desc: Rewrite a comment body.
params: ID of the comment to edit.

tools.name: fc_delete_comment
tools.desc: Delete a comment.
params: ID of the comment to delete.

name: Calendar
blurb: Events with times, all-day flags, recurrence and invitees. fc_fetch_calendar_items also picks up dated tasks and milestones.

tools.name: fc_fetch_events
tools.desc: List calendar events.
params: Restrict to one project. Omit for all.

tools.name: fc_fetch_event
tools.desc: A single event.

tools.name: fc_add_event
tools.desc: Create an event, optionally recurring, with invitees.
params: 1 for an all-day event, 0 for a timed one.
1 notifies the organizer when invitees respond.

tools.name: fc_edit_event
tools.desc: Edit an event's title, timing, recurrence or attachments.
params: ID of the event to edit.

tools.name: fc_delete_event
tools.desc: Delete an event.
params: ID of the event to delete.

tools.name: fc_fetch_calendar_items
tools.desc: Everything dated in a project — events plus tasks and milestones with dates.
params: Restrict to one project. Omit for all.

name: Discussions
blurb: Threaded conversations, optionally sticky or private to named users.

tools.name: fc_fetch_discussions
tools.desc: List discussions in a project.

tools.name: fc_fetch_discussion
tools.desc: A single discussion.

tools.name: fc_add_discussion
tools.desc: Start a discussion, filed under an existing or brand-new list.
params: Existing list to file it under.
Title for a new list to create for it.
User IDs allowed to see it when private.

tools.name: fc_edit_discussion
tools.desc: Rename, re-file or pin a discussion.
params: ID of the discussion to edit.
Title for a new list to move it into.

tools.name: fc_delete_discussion
tools.desc: Delete a discussion.
params: ID of the discussion to delete.

name: Issue Tracker
blurb: Bug and request tracking. Status and type are project-defined workflow IDs, so read them off an existing issue first.

tools.name: fc_fetch_issues
tools.desc: List issues in a project.

tools.name: fc_fetch_issue
tools.desc: A single issue.

tools.name: fc_add_issue
tools.desc: File an issue.
params: Project-defined type ID, e.g. bug or feature.

tools.name: fc_edit_issue
tools.desc: Update an issue's fields, status or assignee.
params: ID of the issue to edit.

tools.name: fc_delete_issue
tools.desc: Delete an issue.
params: ID of the issue to delete.

name: Milestones
blurb: Dated goalposts you can hang tasks off via fc_batch_edit_tasks and its ms_id field.

tools.name: fc_fetch_milestones
tools.desc: List milestones in a project.

tools.name: fc_fetch_milestone
tools.desc: A single milestone.

tools.name: fc_add_milestone
tools.desc: Create a milestone.
params: 0 not started, 1 completed, 2 in progress, 3 invalid, 4 review.

tools.name: fc_edit_milestone
tools.desc: Update a milestone.
params: ID of the milestone to edit.

tools.name: fc_delete_milestone
tools.desc: Delete a milestone.
params: ID of the milestone to delete.

name: Time tracking
blurb: Log minutes, run timers and mark work billed. Timer actions verify the entry actually changed state.

tools.name: fc_fetch_times
tools.desc: List time entries in a project.

tools.name: fc_fetch_time
tools.desc: A single time entry.

tools.name: fc_add_time
tools.desc: Log time, or start a running timer.
params: Whose time this is. Defaults to you; the call fails if it cannot be determined.
1 or true creates it as a running timer.

tools.name: fc_edit_time
tools.desc: Adjust an entry's duration, date, note or owner.
params: ID of the entry to edit.

tools.name: fc_delete_time
tools.desc: Delete a time entry.
params: ID of the entry to delete.

tools.name: fc_time_action
tools.desc: Start, stop, bill or unbill an entry. If nothing actually changed, the call fails rather than reporting success.
params: ID of the entry to act on.

name: Wikis
blurb: Versioned pages with private and public visibility. Edits can overwrite or save as a new version.

tools.name: fc_fetch_wikis
tools.desc: List wiki pages in a project.
params: asc or desc by title. Default asc.

tools.name: fc_fetch_wiki
tools.desc: A single wiki page.

tools.name: fc_add_wiki
tools.desc: Create a wiki page.
params: Page content — HTML or plain text.
Existing wiki folder to file it under.
Title for a new folder to create.
User IDs allowed to view it when private.

tools.name: fc_edit_wiki
tools.desc: Edit a page — overwrite it, or save the edit as a new version.
params: ID of the page to edit.
Title for a new folder to move it into.
User IDs allowed to view it.
true saves the edit as a new version instead of overwriting.

tools.name: fc_delete_wiki
tools.desc: Delete a wiki page.
params: ID of the page to delete.

tools.name: fc_add_wiki_version
tools.desc: Add a new version to an existing page.

name: CRM
blurb: CRM tasks and call logs. These live on a group (the CRM workspace), not a project — pass group_id.

tools.name: fc_fetch_crm_tasks
tools.desc: List CRM tasks in a group.
params: Group whose CRM tasks to fetch.

tools.name: fc_fetch_crm_task
tools.desc: A single CRM task.

tools.name: fc_add_crm_task
tools.desc: Create a CRM task against a contact.
params: CRM task type ID — call, meeting, to-do.

tools.name: fc_edit_crm_task
tools.desc: Update a CRM task.
params: ID of the CRM task to edit.

tools.name: fc_delete_crm_task
tools.desc: Delete a CRM task.
params: ID of the CRM task to delete.

tools.name: fc_fetch_crm_calls
tools.desc: List CRM calls in a group.

tools.name: fc_fetch_crm_call
tools.desc: A single CRM call.

tools.name: fc_add_crm_call
tools.desc: Log a call, inbound or outbound.
params: When it happened or is scheduled.

tools.name: fc_edit_crm_call
tools.desc: Update a logged call.
params: ID of the call to edit.

tools.name: fc_delete_crm_call
tools.desc: Delete a logged call.
params: ID of the call to delete.

name: Users & account
blurb: Who is who, plus account-level operations. Several of these are irreversible — check the badges.

tools.name: fc_fetch_users
tools.desc: Every user you share a workspace with. Use it to resolve assigned_to_id.

tools.name: fc_fetch_current_user
tools.desc: The authenticated user.

tools.name: fc_fetch_user
tools.desc: A user by ID.

tools.name: fc_fetch_groups
tools.desc: All groups, without their projects or apps. Prefer fc_get_groups_projects.

tools.name: fc_update_current_user
tools.desc: Update your own profile. Changing email or password needs current_password.
params: Required when changing password or email.

tools.name: fc_register_user
tools.desc: Register a new Freedcamp account.

tools.name: fc_validate_email
tools.desc: Check whether an email address is valid and available.

tools.name: fc_request_password_reset
tools.desc: Send a password reset email.
params: Address to send the link to.

tools.name: fc_apply_password_reset
tools.desc: Complete a password reset with the key from the email.

tools.name: fc_delete_avatar
tools.desc: Remove your current avatar image.

tools.name: fc_delete_account
tools.desc: Delete the whole account. Requires your password and is not reversible.
params: Confirmation value required by the API.

name: Notifications
blurb: Read your activity feed and mark things read, one at a time or in bulk.

tools.name: fc_fetch_notifications
tools.desc: Recent notifications — last 60 days, things you follow.

tools.name: fc_fetch_all_notifications
tools.desc: Every notification, with no date or following filter.

tools.name: fc_fetch_notifications_by_project
tools.desc: Notifications for one project.

tools.name: fc_update_notification_read
tools.desc: Mark a single notification read.

tools.name: fc_edit_notifications
tools.desc: Bulk update notification state.
params: Notifications to update, each carrying an item_u_key.

name: Files
blurb: Upload from a path or base64, attach to any item or comment, or stage a temporary record and attach it later via attached_ids.

tools.name: fc_fetch_file
tools.desc: File metadata by ID.

tools.name: fc_upload_file
tools.desc: Upload a file and attach it to a project, item or comment. Send file_path or content_base64.
params: Absolute path to a local file. This or content_base64.
Base64 file contents. This or file_path.
App to attach it to, e.g. 2 Tasks.
1 uploads it as temporary; attach later via attached_ids.

tools.name: fc_add_file_meta
tools.desc: Create a metadata record for a file uploaded elsewhere.
params: App the file is attached to.

tools.name: fc_upload_avatar
tools.desc: Upload a new avatar for the current user.
params: Absolute path to the image. This or content_base64.
Base64 image contents. This or file_path.

tools.name: fc_delete_file
tools.desc: Delete a file.
params: ID of the file to delete.

name: Custom fields & links
blurb: Define custom field templates for Tasks, the Issue Tracker or CRM, and cross-link items between apps.

tools.name: fc_fetch_cf_templates
tools.desc: List custom field templates, with each field's cf_id.
params: App to list templates for. Default 2 (Tasks).

tools.name: fc_add_cf_template
tools.desc: Create a custom field template — a named set of fields.
params: Fields to create: { title, type, f_required, cf_order, currency_code, dd_options }.
Owner user ID. Defaults to you.

tools.name: fc_edit_cf_template
tools.desc: Rename a template, replace its fields, remove fields, or archive it.
params: ID of the template to edit.

tools.name: fc_fetch_linked_items
tools.desc: Items linked to a given item.
params: App that owns the item, e.g. 2 Tasks.

tools.name: fc_add_linked_items
tools.desc: Link an item to items in any app.
params: App that owns the source item.
Map of target app ID (string key) to an array of item IDs.

name: Account & misc
blurb: Invitations, timezones, backups and account state. Small tools, occasionally exactly what you need.

tools.name: fc_fetch_invitations
tools.desc: Pending invitations addressed to you.

tools.name: fc_respond_invitation
tools.desc: Accept or decline an invitation.
params: Extra response value some invitation types need.
Project the invitation is for, if applicable.

tools.name: fc_fetch_timezones
tools.desc: Every timezone the API accepts — useful before setting one on a profile.

tools.name: fc_fetch_backups
tools.desc: Account backups available for download.

tools.name: fc_fetch_wipe_current
tools.desc: Current account-wipe state.
